panels.title: 📊 Numerical Feature Drift: MonthlyCharges Serving Mean vs Training Baseline

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS "time", AVG(monthly_charges) AS "Serving Hourly Mean", 64.76 AS "Baseline Training Mean ($64.76)" FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND monthly_charges IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC;

panels.title: 📑 Categorical Feature Drift: Contract Type Serving Share (%)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS "time", COUNT(CASE WHEN contract = 'Month-to-month' THEN 1 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Month-to-month Share", COUNT(CASE WHEN contract = 'One year' THEN 1 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "One Year Share", COUNT(CASE WHEN contract = 'Two year' THEN 1 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "Two Year Share" FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC;

panels.title: 🎯 Model Prediction Behavior: Churn Rate (%) Over Time

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS "time", (COUNT(CASE WHEN prediction = 'Yes' THEN 1 END)::float / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS "Predicted Churn Rate" FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC;

panels.title: 📈 Model Confidence: Mean Churn Probability Trend

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', created_at) AS "time", AVG(churn_probability) AS "Avg Churn Probability", MAX(churn_probability) AS "Max Churn Probability", MIN(churn_probability) AS "Min Churn Probability" FROM predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC;
